task: #230 — abilities re-bound to the effect the source map really used

joinContract.method: ggdDocs proposes; an exact name decides, else the HERO NUMBER decides
joinContract.why: VFX_BINDINGS' slotFromNumber crosses Saber's Q/W against content, so the slot letter cannot be the key. And the NAME cannot be the key either: GGD carries its own skill names by design, so 29 rows across 6 heroes had already drifted off the join. The hero number is the one half that may not float (#777).
